# javdb-cli Copilot Instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and its task-specific `.agents/skills/javdb-cli-*/SKILL.md` routes. These instructions work without any personal skill collection.

Use `go.mod`, checked-in workflows, and the local test skill for commands. Keep remote CLI operations on the public `sdk/` boundary, preserve the separate pipeline and asset-stream contracts, and never expose passwords or JWTs. Read the development skill before generating source changes and the media skill before changing HLS or file publication.
